game_concept: A tower defense set in Snowy Hold – Hearth Hall, a warm hearth hall: the hold guard must hold off blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Function Pipeline: Chain one function's output into the next to push hot soup pots down a processing line.
theme: Snowy Hold – Hearth Hall: a warm hearth hall
core_gameplay_loop: In Hearth Hall, repeat each round: Chain one function's output into the next to push hot soup pots down a processing line. Then check pipeline and advance.
player_objective: Protect the sleigh from blizzard sprites in Hearth Hall: keep pipeline above zero until the 34-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 5 (applied tier): Function Pipeline
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 6, Level 5, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

Survive for 34 seconds to complete the level.
